Minor, not a blocker.

Mobile KundliScreen.js wires up form (Name/DOB/TOB/POB) + chart switcher (D1/D9/D7/D10) + tabs (Charts/Overview/Analysis/Remedies); imports NorthIndianChart correctly from ../../components/NorthIndianChart.
